response.overview: A message from the animators: When the father falls, it is not just his body that collapses, but the entire family with him. This film is not just an animated scene; it is a mirror reflecting the reality of many families who lose their pillars in an instant. But it is also a message about love that does not break easily, even under bombardment. Bodies may fall apart, but the bonds that unite us remain alive. Can the world see what is happening? And can other hands reach out to lift those who fall before it is too late? Made by children between the ages 9-12 from Deir al-Balah, Gaza.
response.title: Hugs Under Bombs
